=== HINT 3: Method Structure ===

PLAYER.USE_ITEM PATTERN:
- Step 1: Check if the player has the item (inventory.has_item)
- Step 2: Handle each item type differently
  - med_patch: only on "self", heals, then consume
  - ration_pack: only on "self", consume
  - keycard: not consumed, used on doors/targets
  - torch: not consumed, just describes light
  - unknown item: return a "don't know how" message

KEY CONCEPTS
- Check inventory BEFORE trying to use an item
- Different items have different behaviors
- Some items get consumed, some don't
- Always return a descriptive string
- Use if/elif/else to branch by item type

Run validate.py to check your work!
